name: John Mendoza
office: Pomona Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 1

items.text: John Mendoza previously served eight years on the board of the Three Valleys Municipal Water District and was a member of the Pomona Redistricting Commission and a temporary parking committee. He circulated a petition in 2013 to replace at-large school board elections with trustee areas. His petition helped lead to the district's adoption of a five-trustee-area system in 2015. He later gathered enough signatures to trigger a vote on expanding the board to seven members. In a 2026 candidate questionnaire, he said he supports providing salary, health care and retirement incentives for district employees. He also stated the board should set policy and goals and conduct community outreach to maintain and improve education.
